preheader: Anthropic's $42B loss revealed, 30-year yields hit 2002 highs, and McKinsey's AI job outlook.

lead.headline: Anthropic's prospectus reveals a $42 billion loss and massive computing plans
lead.body: Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows the company posted a $42 billion net loss in 2025 as it prepares to spend $518 billion on computing capacity. The startup is targeting a $2 trillion valuation based on the belief that artificial intelligence will transform the global economy. It also dedicated nearly a third of the filing to risk factors, including potential existential threats.
lead.why: When evaluating venture-backed companies in your finance classes, pay close attention to cash burn. Anthropic is betting that massive front-loaded spending will create an insurmountable competitive moat before capital markets tighten.

stories.headline: 30-year Treasury yields climb to their highest mark since 2002
stories.body: Long-term U.S. government bond yields rose on Tuesday to levels not seen in over two decades. The move reflects ongoing investor worries about stubborn inflation and central bank interest rate policy.
stories.why: Higher benchmark yields increase borrowing costs across capital markets, which can depress equity valuations and slow down corporate dealmaking.

stories.headline: The U.S. activates a $1 billion import ban on Canadian goods
stories.body: A trade ban covering nearly $1 billion worth of Canadian goods took effect early Tuesday. The restricted items include dairy, motorcycles, and roughly $800 million in alcoholic beverages.

sources.name: ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos

stories.why: Sudden trade policy shifts disrupt supply chains and pricing strategies, which are core case study topics in your Merage business operations courses.

stories.headline: Nvidia alumni are driving a wave of robotics startups
stories.body: Former Nvidia engineers are leaving the chip maker to launch physical AI and robotics startups backed by venture capital. Nvidia also stands to gain from their success, since these new ventures rely heavily on its hardware ecosystem.
stories.why: Tracking where senior engineers migrate gives you an early look at where startup capital and internship opportunities will concentrate next.

stories.headline: Leading scientists urge governments to prepare for self-improving AI
stories.body: Researchers including Geoffrey Hinton and Yoshua Bengio issued a warning about a potential intelligence explosion. Their report notes that automated AI research could soon compress years of technological advancement into months.
stories.why: Anticipated government regulations on frontier AI will directly shape tech consulting advisory work and enterprise risk management.

stories.headline: McKinsey projects AI could shift 11 million U.S. workers by 2035
stories.body: A report from McKinsey warns that advances in automation could require 11 million Americans to change occupations over the next decade. The displacements are expected to hit office, retail, and logistics roles hardest.
stories.why: Helping corporations navigate workforce restructuring and digital adoption will be a primary revenue driver for consulting firms over the next decade.

stories.headline: New graduates push back against excessive entry-level job criteria
stories.body: A new survey found that 77% of recent college graduates believe employers demand too much prior experience for entry-level positions. Many applicants feel shut out despite holding relevant internships and extracurricular credentials.
stories.why: To stand out early in business school, focus on securing project leadership and hands-on consulting club experience rather than relying on coursework alone.

stories.headline: UC Irvine researchers design stealth chemotherapy to protect healthy cells
stories.body: Scientists at UCI developed a targeted cancer drug that carries a molecular safety lock. The drug remains inactive until it enters cancer cells displaying specific protein-destroying activity, leaving healthy tissue unharmed.

stories.headline: Novak Djokovic prepares for China Open return after fitness break
stories.body: Novak Djokovic confirmed his body is responding well in training as the 24-time Grand Slam champion targets momentum at the China Open following recent physical setbacks.

term.name: Capital Expenditure (CapEx)
term.definition: Capital expenditure is the money a company spends to buy, build, or upgrade long-term physical assets, such as data centers or high-end servers. Unlike everyday operating costs, CapEx is recorded on the balance sheet and depreciated over time. Anthropic's projected $518 billion computing commitment represents an extraordinary CapEx bet to dominate frontier AI infrastructure.

serve.headline: Instinct raises $1B at a $10B valuation to build consumer AI agents
serve.body: AI assistant startup Instinct secured $1 billion in Series C funding led by Sequoia Capital, lifting its valuation to $10 billion. The company develops autonomous software agents capable of executing multi-step tasks rather than simply answering user prompts.
